description: This file defines the ProviderModel class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically representing an OpenID Connect provider entity. It incorporates serialization traits and constructs the model to include provider details such as ID, name, URL, status, and client ID, for use in the HRM's API layer.

classes.name: ProviderModel
classes.description: Model class representing an OpenID provider, used for serialization and API data exchange within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProviderModel with an AuthProviderExtraDetails entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
